configurePresets.name: base
configurePresets.description: Repo-owned knobs only. The compiler, the vcpkg toolchain file and SUSHIRUNTIME_DIR are machine-specific and stay out of a committed file: the se CLI reads them from cli/config.local.toml, and CMake's own defaults (clang++ on PATH, ../sushiruntime) cover a plain checkout. Pass -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=... / -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE=... alongside the preset when they are not on PATH.

configurePresets.name: default
configurePresets.description: What `se build` configures: the SushiRuntime execution backend with the test suite compiled and the samples gated off.

configurePresets.name: native
configurePresets.description: The SYCL-free lane: no SushiRuntime subproject, and samples/ declares only sandbox and pgs_demo. Its own tree because a native cache cannot be reused by the runtime lane.

configurePresets.name: editor
configurePresets.description: What `se editor` configures. Turning the editor on turns render, input and audio on inside CMakeLists.txt, so they are not repeated here.

configurePresets.name: player
configurePresets.description: What `se player` configures. Turning the player on turns render and input on inside CMakeLists.txt, so they are not repeated here.
